raw_en.flavor: "Adiya shrouded herself in shadow and walked amongst men. From her countless mouths poured the song of the abyss. Its sound drowned the mind in fog as she came to feed." -Annals of Hadal
raw_en.name: Litany of Sable

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}魔指利爪{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}，且当你获得一层{c_important}{u}暗影形态{/u}{/c}时会发射额外的利爪。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “艾迪亚将真身隐于暗影，在凡人之间游荡。深渊的挽歌从她那千万张巨口中涌出。当她前来大快朵颐时，那魔音足以让所有心智陷入迷惘。”——《哈达尔编年史》
raw_zh.name: 黑岩祷文

In addition, kills Heal you for {c_number}5%{/c} of your Maximum Life.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Fiacla-Géar's druids lived in harmony with nature. The Talons of Ifeh walked a different path. They surrendered their souls to the wilds, becoming more beast than man.
raw_en.name: Ifeh's Dire Totem

affixesDesc: x[6 - 10]% 毒素 伤害增倍

{c_unique}{c_important}灰熊狂怒{/c}现在被视作{c_important}狼人{/c}技能，能使你化身为一头恐怖狼人。恐怖狼人无法获得护甲值加成，但会获得 {c_random}[100 - 125]%[x]{/c} 的暴击伤害加成、{c_random}[100 - 125]%[x]{/c} 的额外毒素伤害以及灵力消耗减免。此外，消灭敌人会为你治疗 {c_number}5%{/c} 的生命上限。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 菲亚克拉·盖尔的德鲁伊与自然和谐共处。而伊菲之爪则走上了另一条路。他们将灵魂献给了荒野，变得兽性多过人性。

raw_zh.flavor: 古代库拉斯特的雏形是在很久以前由石族确立的，是他们用土石造就了奇迹。然而，与维兹杰雷的战争迫使他们放下了刻石的斧凿，拿起了杀人的戈矛。如今，石头在他们手里只剩下了一种用途，那就是被当成投石，砸向敌人。

raw_en.flavor: "Stand tall, for on this day we bring the Light of Inarius to a land consumed by darkness!" - Urivar, before the Battle for Scosglen
raw_en.name: Light's Rebuke

affixesDesc: {c_unique}被{c_important}神恩长枪{/c}首次攻击刺穿的敌人受到{c_important}神恩长枪{/c}后续攻击的伤害提高 {c_random}[150 - 200]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “挺起胸膛，今天我们将伊纳瑞斯的圣光带到这片被黑暗吞噬的土地！” - 索格伦战役前的乌里瓦尔
raw_zh.name: 圣光非难

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} gains {c_number}3{/c} additional rays and deals {c_random}[85 - 105]%{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The sun looked upon man and judged him unworthy. In wrath, the sins of the faithless were scourged in flame upon their flesh. And the day was made pure again." - Canticle of the Penitent, Verse XV
raw_en.name: Sunbrand

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}天堂之怒{/c}获得额外 {c_number}3{/c} 道光束，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[85 - 105]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “太阳俯瞰众生，裁定其不配享恩泽。怒焰之中，无信者的罪愆被火焰烙刻于身。至此，白昼复归纯净。”——《忏悔圣歌》第十五节
raw_zh.name: 阳炎烙印

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} gains the Epicenter Variant for free and deals {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Whereas Andariel relishes the anticipation of pain and the fear it creates, Duriel only cares of the existence and propagation of agony." -Book of Adria
raw_en.name: Scourge of Duriel

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}幽冥锁链{/c}免费获得震源变体，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “安达莉尔沉醉于对折磨的期盼以及由此滋生的恐惧，但督瑞尔在乎的，只有纯粹苦痛的降临与蔓延。”——《艾德莉亚之书》
raw_zh.name: 督瑞尔的灾祸

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills gain all Upgrades for free. Damaging an enemy with a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill causes them to take {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c} increased damage from your other {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills for {c_number}10{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Tremble not before the one who has mastered a thousand incantations. Tremble before the one who has made a single spell his gospel, his body, his breath." -One Who Never Sleeps
raw_en.name: Gospel of the Devotee

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}基础{/c}技能免费获得所有升级。使用{c_important}基础{/c}技能对敌人造成伤害时，使其受到来自你其他{c_important}基础{/c}技能的伤害提高 {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “不用畏惧通晓一千种咒语的敌人，但应敬畏熟识一种法术，将其奉为福音、纳为身躯、融入气息之人。”——无眠者
raw_zh.name: 虔诚者福音

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} deals {c_random}[40 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased damage and explodes for {c_number}40%{/c} of its total damage when dissipating.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The height of the Moon Clan's power brought a beast that instilled dread upon Khanduras. More demon than Khazra, the one dubbed the Stormhorn left charred brands where cities once stood.
raw_en.name: Strike of Stormhorn

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}球状闪电{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 60]%[x]{/c}，在消散时会发生爆炸并造成其总伤害 {c_number}40%{/c} 的伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 月族强大的力量引来了一头令堪杜拉斯人人生畏的猛兽。这头被称为“风暴利角”的生物，与其说是卡兹拉，倒更像是恶魔——其所到之处，城市尽皆化作焦土。
raw_zh.name: 风暴利角之击

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Deep Freeze{/c} gains the Glacier Variant for free and its final blast deals {c_random}[400 - 500]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Mage halls across Sanctuary boast of their prodigious alumni, trained from an early age. However, one might argue that these talented children would have become powerful Wizards in their own right.
raw_en.name: Shanar's Resonance

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}深度冻结{/c}免费获得冰川变体，并且最终爆炸造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[400 - 500]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 庇护之地各处的法师殿堂都夸耀着从小接受训练的杰出校友。然而，有人可能会说，这些天赋异禀的孩子凭借自身的实力，本就能成为强大的法师。
raw_zh.name: 莎娜的共鸣

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} now returns to you dealing {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Many adventurers have sailed the Frozen Sea, but most are lost to the depths. Legend has it the first to return spoke of a vast treasure. Alas, he could not carry it alone. Save for one relic.
raw_en.name: Onyx Soul

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}冰霜球{/c}现在会向你飞回，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 许多冒险者都在冰封之海上航行过，但大多数人都迷失在了深渊之中。传说第一位归来的人曾提到过一笔巨大的宝藏。唉，他一个人根本搬不走。除了一件圣物。
raw_zh.name: 玛瑙之魂

affixesDesc: {c_unique}You gain Primary Stat equal to {c_random}[85 - 115]%[x]{/c} of your {c_important}Dexterity{/c}.{/c}{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "It's just a cat," said Ankaj. Her uncle leaned in, "You are spiritborn. Look deeper." In its amber eyes, Ankaj saw the passing of ages, fixed on a single thought: "Mouse." The cat smacked its lips.
raw_en.name: Henri's Perquisition

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你获得相当于自身{c_important}敏捷{/c} {c_random}[85 - 115]%[x]{/c} 的主要属性。{/c}{/c}

raw_en.name: Eye of Baal

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}灵魂碎片{/c}技能及其恶魔造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c}。施放{c_important}灵魂碎片{/c}技能会使你造成的所有伤害提高 {c_number}10%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}15{/c} 秒，最多提高 {c_number}50%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “当皓月化作猩红之际，便是巴尔睁眼之时。向他献上毁灭的狂欢，他必将以无上的力量作为恩赐。”——《三神教仪式》
raw_zh.name: 巴尔之眼

affixesDesc:
{c_mythic}Every {c_number}2{/c} seconds, you randomly mark a Nearby enemy. Marked enemies are {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, and your attacks against them are guaranteed to Critically Strike.

Hitting a marked enemy {c_number}10{/c} times clears the mark from them.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: In the days when Ajaw Y'ishich ruled Nahantu, the phoenix constellation's crown fell in burning glory. From it was forged a blade that withered valor, heralding an age of despair.
raw_en.name: Nesekem, the Herald

affixesDesc:
{c_mythic}每 {c_number}2{/c} 秒随机标记一名附近的敌人。被标记的敌人陷入{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}状态，且你对其发动的攻击必定暴击。

命中被标记的敌人 {c_number}10{/c} 次后，移除其标记。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 在阿哈乌·伊希奇统治纳罕涂之时，凤凰星座中最耀眼的一颗星带着熊熊烈焰，坠落在了这片土地之上。后来，人们用其陨石打造了一把长刃，而正是这柄长刃，预示这一个绝望时代的到来——在它面前，勇气也会枯萎，雄心也会颓靡。
raw_zh.name: 涅塞科姆，绝望先驱

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Casting an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill grants or amplifies its matching Primary Spirit Hall Bonus with {c_random}[350 - 400]%[+]{/c} potency for {c_number}15{/c} seconds.

Your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills each gain an additional Skill Type:
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_important}The Seeker{/c} is a {c_important}Focus{/c} Skill.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_important}The Hunter{/c} is a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_important}The Devourer{/c} is a {c_important}Potency{/c} Skill.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_important}The Protector{/c} is a {c_important}Defensive{/c} Skill.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Fear not the limits of your flesh, Spiritborn!  As our ancestors said: wushe nak pa! Transcend your being!" - Maka
raw_en.name: Wushe Nak Pa

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}施放{c_important}终极{/c}技能将提供或增强与其对应的主要众灵之厅加成，强度为 {c_random}[350 - 400]%[+]{/c}，持续 {c_number}15{/c} 秒。

你的每项{c_important}终极{/c}技能还会额外获得一个技能类别:
{icon:bullet, 1.2}{c_important}寻迹者{/c}将被视为{c_important}念力{/c}技能。
{icon:bullet, 1.2}{c_important}追猎者{/c}将被视为{c_important}机动{/c}技能。
{icon:bullet, 1.2}{c_important}吞噬者{/c}将被视为{c_important}增威{/c}技能。
{icon:bullet, 1.2}{c_important}保护者{/c}将被视为{c_important}防御{/c}技能。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “不要畏惧肉体的桎梏，灵巫！正如先人所说：Wūshe Nak Pa！因此，努力超越自我吧！”——马卡
raw_zh.name: 乌阇南帕

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal [2,200 - 5,400] Poisoning Damage over 10 seconds
implict: +15.0% Chance for an extra item from the Purveyor of Curiosities
raw_en.name: Edge

affixesDesc: 幸运一击: 最多有 40% 几率在 10 秒内造成 [2,200 - 5,400] 点中毒伤害
implict: +15.0% 几率从珍品商处额外获得一件物品
raw_zh.name: 锐锋

implict: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40.0% Chance to deliver a Crushing Blow
raw_en.name: Infinity

options.desc: x[45 - 55]% 闪电 伤害增倍
x[45 - 55]% 火焰 伤害增倍
x[45 - 55]% 毒素 伤害增倍
x[45 - 55]% 物理 伤害增倍

implict: 幸运一击: 最多有 40.0% 几率造成粉碎一击
raw_zh.name: 无限

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Whirlwind{/c} deals {c_random}[75 - 90]%{/c} increased damage and pulls enemies to you every {c_number}2{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The brutish construction of these gloves belies the strength they bestow. Gohr was clearly no craftsman, but it would be foolish to ignore the triumph of his work." -Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Gohr's Devastating Grips

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}旋风斩{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[75 - 90]%{/c}，并且每 {c_number}2{/c} 秒将敌人拉向你。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “这副手套的粗犷结构掩盖了其中蕴含的力量。戈尔虽然不是工匠，但只有蠢货才会轻视他的作品。”——巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 戈尔的毁灭之握

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Double Swing's{/c} initial sweep deals {c_random}[45.0 - 60.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage and applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}. Subsequent swings deals {c_random}[90.0 - 120.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage and grants {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "When hitting it once doesn't kill it, hit it twice." -Bear Tribe Proverb
raw_en.name: Twin Strikes

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}双重横扫{/c}的初始挥击造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45.0 - 60.0]%[x]{/c}，并施加{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}。后续挥击造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[90.0 - 120.0]%[x]{/c}，并使你获得{c_important}{u}狂暴{/u}{/c}，持续 {c_number}3{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “如果打一次杀不死它，那就打两次。”——熊族谚语
raw_zh.name: 双重打击

affixesDesc: {c_unique}While channeling {c_important}Whirlwind{/c}, you now periodically hurl out a {c_important}Mighty Throw{/c} that deals {c_random}[75.0 - 90.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Before Baal's hosts blighted Daken-Shar, the outnumbered northmen clad themselves in barbed mail so that even in death, the demons still bled.
raw_en.name: Bane of Ahjad-Den

affixesDesc: x[12 - 20]% 物理 伤害增倍
{c_unique}引导{c_important}旋风斩{/c}时，你现在会周期性地掷出一次{c_important}蛮力投掷{/c}，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[75.0 - 90.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 在巴尔的大军踏破达肯沙尔之际，寡不敌众的北地勇士穿上了带着倒刺的锁甲——纵使抛却性命，也要让恶魔血流不止。
raw_zh.name: 阿扎登的灾厄

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Mighty Throw{/c} now gains multiplicative damage instead of cooldown from {c_important}Cooldown Reduction{/c} at {c_random}[75.0 - 100.0]%{/c} effectiveness.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Even as a boy, Qual-Kehk's strength was the stuff of legend. It was said he could split oak trees in two with one throw of his blade." -Feats of Arreat, Vol. IV
raw_en.name: Might of Qual-Kehk

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}蛮力投掷{/c}现在将根据{c_important}冷却时间缩减{/c}效果改为获得积数级的伤害加成（而非冷却时间缩减），转换比例为 {c_random}[75.0 - 100.0]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “早在他还是个孩童时，夸尔凯克的力量便已堪称传奇。据说，他只需掷出一次利刃，就能将坚硬的橡树一分为二。”——《亚瑞特伟业》第四卷
raw_zh.name: 夸尔凯克的伟力

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} is now a {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skill. In addition, {c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} increases your damage by {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c} while in Werewolf form for the duration.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "They who live by fang and claw forget the feeling of human feet on soil. Of cold air on bare skin. Man and beast...thoughts, desires...merge together like blood spilled in a stream." -Nafain
raw_en.name: Dark Howl

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}挫志咆哮{/c}现在是{c_important}狼人{/c}技能。此外，{c_important}挫志咆哮{/c}持续期间，你在狼人形态下造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “靠尖牙和利爪生存的人，会忘记人类双脚踏在泥土上的感觉。忘记冷空气拂过肌肤的触感。人与野兽……思想、欲望……像洒落溪流的鲜血一般交融在一起。”——纳菲恩
raw_zh.name: 黑暗嚎叫

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} gains {c_number}1{/c} additional strike each time it grows and deals {c_random}[20 - 25]%[x]{/c} bonus damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The storm caller returns, day after day, demanding to meet the Tree. He beats his chest and demonstrates his powers, refusing to believe that he will never be chosen."
- Excerpt from Gulyas' Diary
raw_en.name: Unsung Ascetic's Wraps

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}雷暴{/c}每次扩大时会额外造成 {c_number}1{/c} 次打击，并且造成 {c_random}[20 - 25]%[x]{/c} 额外伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“日复一日，风暴召唤者一再登门，要求觐见秘语之树。他捶胸顿足，向我展示自己的力量，不愿相信自己竟会无福受选。”
——摘自古亚斯的日记
raw_zh.name: 无名苦行僧的裹手

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your attacks randomly deal {c_number}1%{/c} to {c_random}[250 - 300]%{/c} of their normal damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Will you let fear cheat you, or will you risk everything to find understanding? After all, death is simply the coin with which we purchase life."
- Zurke
raw_en.name: Fists of Fate

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的攻击命中时会随机造成其普通伤害的 {c_number}1%{/c} 至 {c_random}[250 - 300]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: "你会让恐惧欺骗你一生，还是会不惜一切代价去领悟真谛？毕竟，死亡只不过是我们用来交换生命的钱币。" - 祖尔克
raw_zh.name: 命运之拳

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to {u}{c_important}Freeze{/c}{/u} enemies for {c_number}1{/c} second.

You deal {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c} increased damage to {u}{c_important}Frozen{/c}{/u} enemies.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A touch so frigid it stops the heart and chills the very soul.
raw_en.name: Frostburn

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}幸运一击:{/c} 最多有 {c_number}50%{/c} 几率{u}{c_important}冻结{/c}{/u}敌人，持续 {c_number}1{/c} 秒。

你对{u}{c_important}被冻结{/c}{/u}敌人造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 如此的冰冷，触碰的瞬间几乎冻结了心跳、刺痛了灵魂。
raw_zh.name: 霜燃

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Damaging enemies with a Non-{c_important}Basic{/c} Skill cast marks them for {c_number}3{/c} seconds. When a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill first hits a marked enemy, the {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill's damage is echoed to all marked enemies, dealing {c_random}[100 - 125]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Crafted from fragments of Duriel's carapace, wearing these gloves, or being struck by them, causes an agonizing sensation akin to pushing one's hands through a thousand shards of glass.
raw_en.name: Paingorger's Gauntlets

affixesDesc: {c_unique}使用非{c_important}基础{/c}技能对敌人造成伤害会将其标记 {c_number}3{/c} 秒。{c_important}基础{/c}技能首次命中带有标记的敌人时，{c_important}基础{/c}技能的伤害会传递到所有带标记的敌人身上，额外造成 {c_random}[100 - 125]%[x]{/c} 伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这副手套以督瑞尔的甲壳碎片制成, 戴着它或被它击中都会导致剧痛, 如同将手插入千万片碎玻璃一样。
raw_zh.name: 痛苦吞食者的护手

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Attacks apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} to Distant Enemies, and {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} to Close Enemies. You deal {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c} increased damage to Enemies that are both {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Each touch dulls pain. Enemies feel their vigor unravel as the poison withers their marrow and drinks deep of their strength.
raw_en.name: Wyrdskin

affixesDesc: {c_unique}攻击会对远距敌人施加{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}，对近距敌人施加{c_important}{u}虚弱{/u}{/c}。对同时处于{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}和{c_important}{u}虚弱{/u}{/c}状态的敌人造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 每一次触碰都在剥离痛觉。当毒素沁入骨髓、吸尽体力，敌人的生命力便会如乱麻般散尽。
raw_zh.name: 诡邪之皮

affixesDesc: +[14 - 28]% Movement Speed for 4 Seconds After Killing an Elite
raw_en.flavor: Though tarnished by centuries, the bright steel is unmarked by battle. It inspires courage until one sees the padding, stained black with old blood. The names of bygone owners fade in the leather.
raw_en.name: Nemesis Bracers

affixesDesc: +[14 - 28]% 消灭一个精英怪后 4 秒内的移动速度
raw_zh.flavor: 经年锈蚀，亮钢上却不见刀痕。它本能鼓舞勇气，直到你看见衬垫上发黑的陈血。往日主人的名字，已在皮革上模糊难辨。
raw_zh.name: 复仇者护腕

affixesDesc: {c_unique}This item is worthless as its power has been lost.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A relic of Yorin's ill-starred tempering. Regardless of success, Donan proudly displayed them all upon the mantelpiece... in fairer days.
raw_en.name: Wilted Potential

affixesDesc: {c_unique}该物品的力量消散殆尽，现在已经毫无价值了。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 约林回火失败的产物。无论成功与否，多南都会将回火得到的东西自豪地陈列在壁炉架上……可惜这样美好的日子已一去不返。
raw_zh.name: 凋萎潜能

affixesDesc: {c_unique}When you would be damaged for at least {c_number}30%{/c} of your Maximum Life at once, it is instead distributed over the next {c_number}4{/c} seconds and reduced by {c_random}[15 - 20]%{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Despite the Light's blessings, countless Knights Penitent were hewn apart by the infernal hordes. Remnants of their steel lie scattered through the Hells – dwindling lights in the chaos.
raw_en.name: Endurant Faith

affixesDesc: {c_unique}当你即将受到的单次伤害达到生命上限的 {c_number}30%{/c} 时，此伤害会在接下来的 {c_number}4{/c} 秒内陆续生效，且伤害量降低 {c_random}[15 - 20]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 尽管有圣光庇佑，无数的悔罪骑士还是在炼狱魔潮中粉身碎骨。他们的武器碎片也散落在地狱各处——在混沌中逐渐消亡。
raw_zh.name: 忠贞信仰

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Instead of detonating immediately, {c_important}Corpse Explosion{/c} now Summons a {c_important}Volatile Skeleton{/c} that charges at a random enemy and explodes. 

{c_important}Corpse Explosion{/c} deals {c_random}[70 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Can you not hear it? That endless scream from the cold earth beneath your feet!? They are down there, trapped, blind with rage! Waiting to drag us down into the sod!" -Ravings of Madman Gustav
raw_en.name: Howl from Below

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}邪爆{/c}现在不再立即引爆，而是会召唤出一个{c_important}易爆骷髅{/c}冲向一名随机敌人然后爆炸。

{c_important}邪爆{/c}的伤害提高 {c_random}[70 - 90]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “你听不到吗？在你脚下的冰冷大地下方，正不断传来无休无止的尖叫声！？他们被困在里面，被愤怒蒙蔽！正等着把我们全都拖下去！”——狂人古斯塔夫的胡言乱语
raw_zh.name: 地狱哀号

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting {c_important}Blood Surge{/c} picks up {c_number}4{/c} {c_important}{u}Blood Orbs{/c}{/u} around you to expel smaller blood novas, dealing {c_random}[80 - 100]%{/c} of normal damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
In the blood dancer's grasp, a victim lies,
A vessel dried 'neath darkened skies.
Their life extinguished, veins burst and drained,
In Cruor's embrace, forever enchained.
raw_en.name: Cruor's Embrace

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}血涌{/c}会拾取你周围的 {c_number}4{/c} 个{c_important}{u}生命球{/c}{/u}，以释放较小的鲜血新星，造成 {c_random}[80 - 100]%{/c} 的普通伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
受害者躺在血舞者手中，
在阴暗的天幕下，一具躯体干涸了。
生命消逝，血管爆裂并干涸，
在库虏尔的怀抱中，永远被禁锢。
raw_zh.name: 库虏尔之拥

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your maximum number of {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} is increased by {c_number}1{/c} and they are upgraded to Arch-Mages.

Arch-Mages teleport to safety when attacked and their attacks occasionally shatter on impact, dealing {c_random}[80 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage to the enemy and up to {c_number}3{/c} additional targets.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Legends say that the Hand of Naz was not made, but cursed into being. Woe to the living who unearth it, for the price is the same regardless of form. The cavity where a gem once lay is empty.
raw_en.name: The Hand of Naz

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}骷髅法师{/c}最大数量增加 {c_number}1{/c} 名，并且它们升级为大法师。

大法师受到攻击时，会传送回安全的地方。其攻击命中时偶尔会分散开，对目标造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 90]%[x]{/c}，且最多伤害 {c_number}3{/c} 个额外目标。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 相传，纳兹之手并非人力造就，而是因蒙受诅咒才降临世间。凡有生灵将其掘出，都会招致莫名灾祸——只皆因，无论以何种方式触碰此物，所要付出的代价俱是一般。可饶是如此……此物原本镶有宝石，但如今这凹槽里，却已是空空如也。
raw_zh.name: 纳兹之手

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Sever{/c} deals {c_random}[35 - 50]%[x]{/c} increased damage and sends out {c_number}1{/c} additional specter to attack a nearby enemy.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The executioner's hands are imprinted with the essence of every life they have taken. They do not understand this, though. But we who seek Balance do." -Books of Kalan
raw_en.name: Hangman's Hand

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}挥斩{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[35 - 50]%[x]{/c}，并额外派出 {c_number}1{/c} 个幽影攻击一名附近敌人。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “刽子手的双手印有他们所剥夺的每一个生命的精华。然而他们自己并不明白这一点。但我们这些寻求平衡的人明白。”——《卡兰之书》
raw_zh.name: 绞刑官之手

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your maximum number of {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} is increased by {c_number}1{/c}. {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} cleave with their attacks and deal {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c} increased damage.

Commanding them onto a target increases the damage that target takes from your {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} by {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "There is something akin to desire that I have sensed in the dead. A longing to serve, to be of purpose in their new state of being. Do not deny them that purpose." -Books of Kalan
raw_en.name: Deathgrip

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}骷髅战士{/c}最大数量增加 {c_number}1{/c} 个。{c_important}骷髅战士{/c}的攻击会造成顺劈，且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c}。

命令它们攻击一个目标会使该目标受到来自你的{c_important}骷髅战士{/c}的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我在死者身上感受到了一种近乎欲望的东西。一种想要服侍、想要在他们的新存在状态中发挥作用的渴望。不要剥夺他们那个目标。”——《卡兰之书》
raw_zh.name: 死亡之握

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your Essence Generation is increased by {c_random}[30 - 40]%{/c}. Your {c_important}Bone{/c} Skills deal {c_number}0.5%[x]{/c} increased damage for each point of Essence you have when Cast, up to {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "There is a point one can reach, a oneness with the Balance, when a single, silent gesture is enough to summon an army of bone to your command." -Necromancer Mehtan
raw_en.name: Gravewalker's Hand

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的精魂生成量提高 {c_random}[30 - 40]%{/c}。施放时你每有一点精魂，你的{c_important}白骨{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_number}0.5%[x]{/c}，最多提高 {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “当一个人与‘平衡’彻底融为一体时，仅需一个无声的动作，便足以唤起浩荡的白骨大军为你效命。”——死灵法师麦坦
raw_zh.name: 行墓者之手

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Holy Light's{/c} passive now deals {c_random}[390 - 450]{/c} Fire Damage every second in a small area around you. Each time an enemy dies within this aura, it increases its damage by {c_number}15%[x]{/c} and burn area by {c_number}10%[+]{/c} for {c_number}20{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}10{/c} times.

Activating {c_important}Holy Light Aura{/c} refreshes this duration.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Kindle your inner flame. With it, we are the dawn that breaks the night." - Paladin Justelle
raw_en.name: Dawnfire

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}神圣之光{/c}的被动现在每秒在你周围的一个小区域内造成 {c_random}[390 - 450]{/c} 点火焰伤害。每当一名敌人在该光环范围内死亡时，它的伤害提高 {c_number}15%[x]{/c} 且燃烧范围扩大 {c_number}10%[+]{/c}，持续 {c_number}20{/c} 秒，最多叠加 {c_number}10{/c} 次。

激活{c_important}圣光光环{/c}会刷新此持续时间。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “点燃你内心的火焰。有了它，我们就是冲破黑夜的黎明。”——圣骑士正斯泰尔
raw_zh.name: 黎明之火

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Damaging a Close enemy with {c_important}Marksman{/c} or {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skills each grant a {c_number}15%[+]{/c} Attack Speed bonus for {c_number}8{/c} seconds.

While both Attack Speed bonuses are active, you deal {c_random}[45.0 - 60.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage to Close enemies.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "She wished only to protect her sister. She journeyed far to Ivgorod. After years of training she returned home, being the only outsider to ever master the six techniques." -Legends of the Iron Rose
raw_en.name: Fist of the Iron Rose

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}使用{c_important}神射手{/c}或{c_important}刺杀{/c}技能对近距敌人造成伤害时，分别获得 {c_number}15%[+]{/c} 的攻击速度加成，持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒。

当两种攻击速度加成都激活时，你对近距敌人造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45.0 - 60.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “她只想保护自己的妹妹。她跋涉远行至艾葛罗德。经过多年的训练，她回到了家乡，成为了有史以来唯一一个掌握了这六种技艺的异乡人。”——《铁玫瑰传奇》
raw_zh.name: 铁玫瑰之拳

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Casting or Channeling a {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skill grants a stack of Momentum, up to {c_number}10{/c}. Casting a {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skill removes a stack of Momentum.

For each stack of Momentum, you gain:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_random}[2.50 - 3.00]%{/c} Maximum Energy
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_random}[2.50 - 3.00]%[x]{/c} Energy Regeneration
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_random}[5.00 - 6.00]%[x]{/c} Increased Damage{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Pirates rarely gather under a single Captain, but when they do, they raid from Skovos to Xiansai. The last was known as the Scourge of the Twin Seas, and left a crimson wake for decades.
raw_en.name: Sea Lord's Fine Gloves

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}施放或引导{c_important}刺杀{/c}技能会获得一层乘胜追击，最多 {c_number}10{/c} 层。施放{c_important}神射手{/c}技能会移除一层乘胜追击。

每拥有一层乘胜追击，你获得:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_random}[2.50 - 3.00]%{/c} 能量上限
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_random}[2.50 - 3.00]%[x]{/c} 能量回复速度
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_random}[5.00 - 6.00]%[x]{/c} 伤害提高{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 海盗们极少聚集在同一位船长麾下，但一旦如此，他们就会从斯科沃斯一路劫掠至仙塞。上一位被称作“双子海之灾”，并在长达数十年的时间里留下了一道猩红的航迹。
raw_zh.name: 海王精制手套

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting a {c_important}Marksman{/c} or {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skill has a {c_random}[45 - 60]%{/c} chance to Summon a {c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} that mimics that Skill.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Dark wisps creep hungrily across these gloves, like an assassin's blade seeking a life to steal on a moonless night.
raw_en.name: Grasp of Shadow

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}神射手{/c}或{c_important}刺杀{/c}技能有 {c_random}[45 - 60]%{/c} 几率召唤出一个同样使用该技能的{c_important}暗影分身{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 暗影丝条如饥似渴地在这双手套上游走，仿佛刺客的利刃在无月之夜中寻觅着可以窃取的生命。
raw_zh.name: 暗影之握

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Poison or Cold {c_important}Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}35%{/c} chance to deploy a {c_important}Poison Trap{/c} while it is equipped, depending on your equipped {c_important}Poison Trap's{/c} element.

{c_important}Poison Trap{/c} gains the Infiltrator Variant for free and deals {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: From the stump of the Blood Rose oozes a foul and black ichor—bane to flesh and blood. Blade and hide treated in the toxics are worth the fortunes of kings.
raw_en.name: Bands of Ichorous Rose

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}幸运一击:{/c} 使用{c_important}被毒素或冰霜灌注{/c}的技能时，最多有 {c_number}35%{/c} 几率根据你所装备{c_important}剧毒陷阱{/c}的元素类型部署一个{c_important}剧毒陷阱{/c}（需装备）。

{c_important}剧毒陷阱{/c}免费获得渗透者变体，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 血玫瑰的残株上渗出一股恶臭的黑色脓汁——这是血肉之躯的克星。用这种毒素处理过的刀刃和甲胄可谓价值连城。
raw_zh.name: 脓腐玫瑰腕带

affixesDesc: {c_unique}The first direct damage you deal to an enemy is a guaranteed Critical Strike. When a {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skill first Critically Strikes, it gains {c_random}[90 - 120]%[x]{/c} increased damage, and you gain {c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. This can stack up to {c_number}4{/c} over your Maximum {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The Philios Games were said to welcome the prideful, the reckless, and the condemned.
raw_en.name: Gladiator's Triumph

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你对敌人造成的首次直接伤害必定暴击。当{c_important}神射手{/c}技能首次造成暴击时，其伤害提高 {c_random}[90 - 120]%[x]{/c}，并且你获得 {c_number}1{/c} 层{c_important}{u}压制{/u}{/c}。这可以超出你的{c_important}{u}压制{/u}{/c}上限，最多叠加 {c_number}4{/c} 层。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 据说菲力奥斯运动会欢迎那些傲慢者、鲁莽者以及被定罪之人。
raw_zh.name: 角斗士的凯旋

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting {c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} through your {c_important}Firewall{/c} causes it to split into {c_number}3{/c} bolts, each dealing {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Driven to surpass Esu, the wizard Naridan's reckless enchantments caused an inferno, devastating the ancient town of Cagrim. Only the gauntlets remained - a solemn warning to all who dare tame fire.
raw_en.name: Flameweaver

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}火焰弹{/c}穿过你的{c_important}火墙{/c}时，火焰弹会分裂为 {c_number}3{/c} 个火球，每个火球额外造成 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} 伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 为了超越艾苏，法师纳里丹不顾一切地施展附魔，引发了一场炼狱烈焰，摧毁了古老的卡格利姆镇。整个镇只剩下这个护手——这是对所有胆敢驯服火焰的人的郑重警告。
raw_zh.name: 织火者

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Spark{/c} shocks enemies {c_number}1{/c}-{c_number}9{/c} additional times and deals {c_random}[20 - 30]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The bandit lay on the floor, as a bolt of lightning arced between his friends. He watched the Sorceress walk away calmly as his friends fell to the floor, one by one.
raw_en.name: Levin Grasp

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}电花{/c}会对敌人额外造成 {c_number}1{/c} - {c_number}9{/c} 次电击，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[20 - 30]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 强盗倒在地板上，一道闪电在他的朋友们之间跳跃。他看着那个法师平静地走开，而他的朋友们则一个个倒在了地上。
raw_zh.name: 闪电之握

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} pierces through Crowd Controlled and {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} enemies and deals {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"We passed through the Fields of Judgement. The cold there...it chills your bones, and freezes your soul. Only I made it to the summit. The rest sit in prayer for eternity."
- The Pilgrimage of Agoa
raw_en.name: Rimeblood

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}寒霜弹{/c}会穿透被控制和{c_important}{u}不可阻挡{/u}{/c}的敌人，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“我们穿过了审判旷野。那里的寒冷……刺透你的骨头，冻结你的灵魂。只有我到达了顶峰。其余的人只能在永恒中端坐祈祷。”
——《阿戈阿朝圣之旅》
raw_zh.name: 凛霜之血

raw_en.flavor: "While known for their proclivity for mischief, the Sidhe, as the Druids call them, are fiercely loyal and will defend all they consider friend..."  - Sarnakyle
raw_en.name: Sidhe Bindings

affixesDesc: {c_unique}获得{c_important}魔宠{/c}的{c_important}附魔{/c}，且{c_important}魔宠{/c}的{c_important}强度{/c}提高 {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “德鲁伊口中的仙灵素来以调皮捣蛋著称，不过，他们也极为挚诚。只要被他们当成朋友，便会得到其不遗余力的保护……”——萨尔纳基尔
raw_zh.name: 仙灵裹手

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Direct damage is distributed as Poisoning over the next {c_number}10{/c} seconds and reduced by {c_random}[10 - 15]%{/c}.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Direct damage has up to a {c_number}25%{/c} chance based on your Poisoned Life percentage to infect an enemy with {c_important}Touch of Death{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: T'an seized a spear and drove it thrice into his mad brother Tan. Alas, the craftier of the twin gods wove one last cunning snare. In place of blood, the wound wept venom and consumed all in its wake.
raw_en.name: Craze of the Dead God

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}直接伤害会在接下来的 {c_number}10{/c} 秒内转为中毒效果并陆续生效，且伤害量降低 {c_random}[10 - 15]%{/c}。

{c_label}幸运一击: {/c}基于你中毒的生命值比例，直接伤害最多有 {c_number}25%{/c} 的几率对敌人施加{c_important}死亡之触{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 塔安抓起长矛，在谭——他发了疯的双生兄弟——的身上刺了三个窟窿。然而，狡猾的谭却在将死之际布下了一个阴险的圈套：从这位神灵伤口中流出的不是血，而是毒液，吞噬了所经过的一切。
raw_zh.name: 死去神灵的疯狂

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}The Protector{/c} can be invoked at range and Pulls inward with its smashes. Enemies in its area take {c_random}[50 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased damage from your {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skills, doubled while they are Knocked Down or a Boss. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: Wreathed in bark and bone, these gauntlets carry the strength of old simian spirits - wardens of root and canopy.
raw_en.name: Hesha e Kesungi

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}保护者{/c}可以远距离召唤，并且随着重击向内拉近。范围内敌人受到你的{c_important}狂猿{/c}技能伤害提高 {c_random}[50 - 60]%[x]{/c}，当其被击倒或者是首领时，此加成翻倍。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这副护手缠绕在树皮和白骨中，其中寄宿的力量属于古老的狂猿之灵，那些根须与林冠的守护者。
raw_zh.name: 哈夏·厄·克苏吉

affixesDesc: {c_unique}While {c_important}Fiend of Abaddon{/c} is alive you periodically sacrifice all other {c_important}Archfiend Summons{/c}, dealing {c_important}Fiend of Abaddon's{/c} damage around them and increasing {c_important}Fiend of Abaddon's{/c} damage by {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c} per demon killed, up to {c_random}[600 - 750]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}60{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: All of Abaddon is unshrouded before you. The denizens of Sheol tremble, for these hands are the touch of those unutterable ruins.
raw_en.name: Gauntlets of Sheol

affixesDesc: {c_unique}当{c_important}亚巴顿邪魔{/c}存活时，你会周期性牺牲所有其他{c_important}高等恶魔召唤物{/c}，在它们周围造成{c_important}亚巴顿邪魔{/c}的伤害，并且每消灭一只恶魔使{c_important}亚巴顿邪魔{/c}的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c}，最多提高 {c_random}[600 - 750]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}60{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 亚巴顿的所有秘密皆在你面前揭示。地底深处的居民瑟瑟发抖，因为这双手触碰的是那不可言说的废墟。
raw_zh.name: 阴间幽冥护手

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Any {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} grants you all {c_important}Metamorphosis{/c} Upgrades for free and they are {c_random}[50 - 100]%[+]{/c} more potent.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "There are certain thresholds one must not cross. Not because the demonologist will lose their way back, but because they will not return the same as they were before." -Grimoire of Reckoning
raw_en.name: Hand of Apotheosis

affixesDesc: {c_unique}进入任意{c_important}{u}恶魔形态{/u}{/c}，都会免费获得全部{c_important}变形{/c}升级，且其效果提高 {c_random}[50 - 100]%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “有些禁忌的边界是绝不可逾越的。这并非是因为恶魔学者会彻底迷失，而是因为当他们归来时，那具躯壳里装着的，早就不再是原本的那个灵魂了。”——《清算魔典》
raw_zh.name: 神化之手

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Terror Swarm{/c} gains the Devouring Swarm Variant for free and deals {c_random}[60 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Faint screams emanate from the gloves, as if they are imbued with a hundred primal fears.
raw_en.name: Thrice-Woven Nightmare

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}恐惧虫群{/c}免费获得噬咬虫群变体，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 100]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 手套中传出细微的尖叫声，仿佛其中浸染了上百种原始的恐惧。
raw_zh.name: 三重编织噩梦

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Apocalypse{/c} deals up to {c_random}[290 - 350]%[x]{/c} increased damage when cast in {c_important}Sigil of Chaos{/c} based on the number of kills the Sigil has stored. 

{c_important}Apocalypse{/c} is now also a {c_important}Sigil{/c} Skill.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "For demons whose nature is to destroy, where does it end? If everything around them is brought to ruin, I believe their final act of destruction would be themselves." -Deckard Cain
raw_en.name: Hands of the Worldbreaker

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}当在{c_important}混沌符印{/c}中施放时，{c_important}末日浩劫{/c}造成的伤害最多提高 {c_random}[290 - 350]%[x]{/c}，具体取决于该符印记录的击杀数。

{c_important}末日浩劫{/c}现在也视为{c_important}符印{/c}技能。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “对于那些以毁灭为本性的恶魔而言，终点究竟在何方？当周遭的一切皆化为废墟，我相信它们最后的毁灭之举，便是将自己撕碎。”——迪卡德·凯恩
raw_zh.name: 灭世者之手

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}20%{/c} chance to trigger a poison nova that deals {c_number}40%{/c} of the damage dealt over {c_number}5{/c} seconds to enemies in the area.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The horrific whispers of the Maiden of Anguish flicker through your mind, pushing you ever closer to madness...
raw_en.name: Andariel's Visage

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}{c_label}幸运一击: {/c} 最多有 {c_number}20%{/c} 几率触发剧毒新星，在 {c_number}5{/c} 秒内对区域内的敌人造成相当于本次伤害 {c_number}40%{/c} 的毒素伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 痛楚女魔可怕的低语在你的脑海中闪现，让你越来越接近疯狂……
raw_zh.name: 安达莉尔的仪容

raw_en.flavor:
"This headdress was once worn by an assassin disguised as a court mage. Her treachery was unveiled, but not before she used its magic to curse the king's entire lineage."
- The Fall of House Aston
raw_en.name: Harlequin Crest

raw_zh.flavor:
“这个头饰曾经是一个伪装成宫廷法师的刺客佩戴的。她的背叛行径虽然最终暴露，但在那之前，她已经成功用魔法诅咒了国王和他的整个家族。”
——《阿斯顿家族的陨落》
raw_zh.name: 谐角之冠

affixesDesc:
{c_mythic}Succumb to hatred and earn Mother's Favor. Slaughtering enemies briefly steals {c_number}15%[+]{/c} Critical Strike Chance from surrounding allies with Mother's Favor.
Mother's Favor always grants you {c_number}15%[x]{/c} increased damage.{c_mythic}
raw_en.flavor: Beware false prophets donned as sheep yet bearing the stench of wolves. Thou shalt know them by their fruits. For a tree of good cannot produce evil, nor thorns yield a harvest sweet and fair.
raw_en.name: Heir of Perdition

affixesDesc:
{c_mythic}屈服于憎恨并获得圣母的宠爱。消灭敌人会短暂窃取周围拥有圣母的宠爱的盟友 {c_number}15%[+]{/c} 暴击几率。
圣母的宠爱始终使你造成的伤害提高 {c_number}15%[x]{/c}。{c_mythic}
raw_zh.flavor: 虚假的先知会披上绵羊的伪装，但恶狼的臭气还留在他们身上。你们务必小心提防，审视其言行便知其真实模样。要知道，好树从来结不出恶果，从荆棘上也尝不出甜香。
raw_zh.name: 堕狱传承

items.name_zh: 勇武的乔里茨的獠牙盔

affixesDesc: {c_unique}When you gain {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} while already {c_important}{u}Berserk{/u}{/c}, you become more enraged granting {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c} increased damage, {c_number}6{/c} Fury per second, and {c_number}10%{/c} Cooldown Reduction.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: As he fought with side by side with Raekor to liberate the labor camp, Joritz claimed this dented helm from a fallen foe. As his legend grew, its unique shape became synonymous with his great deeds.
raw_en.name: Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty

affixesDesc: {c_unique}当你处于{c_important}{u}狂暴{/u}{/c}状态下再次获得{c_important}{u}狂暴{/u}{/c}时，会变得更为暴怒，使你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c}，每秒获得 {c_number}6{/c} 点怒气，并获得 {c_number}10%{/c} 冷却时间缩减。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 乔里茨在与蕾寇并肩作战解放劳工营地时, 从一位死去的敌人身上取走了这顶凹陷的头盔。随着他的传奇愈发恢宏, 头盔独特的形状成为了他伟大事迹的代名词。
raw_zh.name: 勇武的乔里茨的獠牙盔

affixesDesc: {c_unique}While {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} is active, you deal {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased Fire damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Ah, Burning Hells. You look like one of Zolmog's inbred bastards." -Varyana
raw_en.name: Ugly Bastard Helm

affixesDesc: x[12 - 20]% 火焰 伤害增倍
{c_unique}{c_important}狂战士之怒{/c}激活时，你造成的火焰伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “烈焰地狱啊。你就像是索尔莫格和他近亲生出来的蠢崽子似的。”——瓦尔亚纳
raw_zh.name: 丑陋私生子之盔

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Earth Spike{/c} is now a launched as a projectile. Upon impact, the projectile deals {c_random}[225 - 300]{/c} damage to the target and summons {c_number}2-4{/c} additional {c_important}Earth Spikes{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "You Vizjerei believe your magic is greater than ours, so you come here seeking to become the master of this land? But I am a druid. I am the land!" -Druid Saoirse, at the defeat of Mage Lord Emre
raw_en.name: Will of Stone

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}大地尖刺{/c}现在作为投射物发射。在命中时，该投射物对目标造成 {c_random}[225 - 300]{/c} 点伤害并额外召唤 {c_number}2-4{/c} 根{c_important}大地尖刺{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “你们维兹杰雷人觉得自己的法术更高明，所以想跑来主宰这片土地？但我是一名德鲁伊，我本身就是这片土地！”——德鲁伊萨奥伊瑟，于击败法圣埃姆雷后所言
raw_zh.name: 顽石意志

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Wind Shear{/c} now deals {c_random}[225 - 300]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Wind Shear{/c} has up to a {c_number}20.0%{/c} chance to restore {c_number}100{/c} Spirit.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Lo, Éirin has departed, she wanders with us no longer. May her peace be everlasting under the branches of Glór-an-Fháidha." -Inscription at Túr Dúlra
raw_en.name: Autumnal Crown

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}风剪{/c}现在会在 {c_number}4{/c} 秒内造成 {c_random}[225 - 300]{/c} 点毒素伤害。

{c_label}幸运一击:{/c} {c_important}风剪{/c}最多有 {c_number}20.0%{/c} 几率恢复 {c_number}100{/c} 点灵力。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “瞧，艾琳已经离去，她不再随我们一同浪迹天涯。愿她在橡树荣光的枝头下，享有永恒的安宁。”——图尔·杜拉的铭文
raw_zh.name: 秋日冠冕

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Cyclone Armor{/c} is automatically triggered once every {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

Gain {c_important}Cyclone Armor's{/c} passive and it grants you {c_random}[20 - 30]%{/c} Damage Reduction if you are {c_important}Human{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: 'Twas Gathlen, most tender warden of the elder realm, who reigneth o'er grove and glade. Whosoever he favors shall inherit the wilds. Utter his name, and be embraced.
raw_en.name: Gathlen's Birthright

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}旋风甲{/c}每 {c_number}5{/c} 秒自动触发一次。

获得{c_important}旋风甲{/c}的被动效果；处于{c_important}人类{/c}形态时，它还会使你获得 {c_random}[20 - 30]%{/c} 伤害减免。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 加斯伦者，古老界域之守御，辖幽邃之林并林间旷地。其和善仁厚，无之与匹也。蒙其垂青之人，皆得荒野之恩泽。但诵其名，即蒙纳受。
raw_zh.name: 加斯伦的天命

affixesDesc: {c_unique}When you attempt to {c_important}{u}Incapacitate{/u}{/c} an enemy, you mark them and all surrounding enemies, pulling them in and dealing {c_random}[7.5 - 10.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage to them.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The Sahptev faithful believe in a thousand and one gods. If it takes me as many lifetimes, I will find and kill them all."
- Gaspar Stilbian, Veradani Outcast
raw_en.name: Godslayer Crown

affixesDesc: {c_unique}当你尝试使敌人{c_important}{u}伤残{/u}{/c}时，你会标记该目标及其周围所有的敌人，将其拉向中心并使其受到的伤害提高 {c_random}[7.5 - 10.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“萨菩提信徒信奉一千零一位神灵。就算花上一千零一世，我也要找到他们，将其悉数消灭。”
- 梵罗达尼流亡者加斯帕·斯蒂尔比安
raw_zh.name: 弑神者之冠

affixesDesc: {c_unique}This item counts as {c_important}Jewelry{/c} and increases the effect of any gem socketed into the helm by {c_random}[35 - 50]%[x]{/c}{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Heavy, isn't it?" Leoric said, fussing with his new crown, "The weight alone might topple me from the throne." Archbishop Lazarus only smiled, calm and cold. "It catches the Light well, your grace."
raw_en.name: Leoric's Crown

affixesDesc: {c_unique}该物品视作{c_important}首饰{/c}，并使镶嵌在此头盔中的任意宝石效果提高 {c_random}[35 - 50]%[x]{/c}{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “挺沉的，对吧？”李奥瑞克摆弄着新王冠，“光这分量，就够把我从王座上压下去了。”大主教拉扎鲁斯只淡淡一笑，语气又静又冷：“它映着圣光很衬您，陛下。”
raw_zh.name: 李奥瑞克的王冠

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Each time you use a Skill with a Primary Resource Cost, gain {c_random}[5.0 - 7.5]%[x]{/c} increased damage and Resource Cost is increased by {c_number}30%[+]{/c} for {c_number}6{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}6{/c} times.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The prince of Hatred, fair as maggots over carrion. He claims no throne, crafts no realms, reigning over only a blackened, bitter heart. Some legends name him banished, while others dread his return.
raw_en.name: Crown of Lucion

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每当你使用会消耗主要资源的技能时，获得 {c_random}[5.0 - 7.5]%[x]{/c} 增伤，并且资源消耗增加 {c_number}30%[+]{/c}，持续 {c_number}6{/c} 秒，最多叠加 {c_number}6{/c} 次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 憎恨王子，就像腐肉上的蛆虫。他没有王位，也没有领地，只有一颗黑暗、痛苦的心。有些传说称他遭到了放逐，而在另一些传说里，则弥漫着对他归来的恐惧。
raw_zh.name: 路西昂之冠

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Critical Strikes with {c_important}Bone Spear{/c} form an echo that bursts, dealing {c_random}[60 - 70]%[x]{/c} of its normal damage.

{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} deals {c_random}[60 - 70]%[x]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Rathma is endless. He was the first Ancient, and will remain at the end. He is the master of the Great Cycle of Being. When Death comes for him, why should he fear it?" -Vauntus, Acolyte of Rathma
raw_en.name: Deathless Visage

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}使用{c_important}骨矛{/c}造成暴击会生成一个爆裂回响，造成其普通伤害的 {c_random}[60 - 70]%[x]{/c}。

{c_important}骨矛{/c}造成的暴击伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 70]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “拉斯玛是永恒的。他是第一位上古之人，也会是最后之人。他是万物轮回的主宰。当死亡降临在他身上时，他何惧之有？”——文图斯，拉斯玛的侍僧
raw_zh.name: 不死之面

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your maximum number of {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} and {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} is increased by {c_number}4{/c} and your {c_important}Summon{/c} damage is increased by {c_random}[15.0 - 25.0]%[x]{/c}. 

Commanding {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} also causes {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} to focus the same target for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "There is no true death. There is only the movement from one world to another. I stand in both of these worlds." -Necromancer Zayl
raw_en.name: The Undercrown

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}骷髅战士{/c}和{c_important}骷髅法师{/c}最大数量增加 {c_number}4{/c} 个，并且你的{c_important}召唤{/c}伤害提高 {c_random}[15.0 - 25.0]%[x]{/c}。

命令{c_important}骷髅战士{/c}时，还会使{c_important}骷髅法师{/c}集中攻击同一个目标，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “没有真正的死亡。只有从一个世界到另一个世界的转移。我同时屹立在这两个世界中。”——死灵法师扎伊尔
raw_zh.name: 幽冥王冠

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Soulrift's{/c} duration is increased by {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds for every {c_number}30{/c} Essence you spend while it's active, up to {c_number}8{/c} seconds. 

{c_important}Soulrift{/c} deals {c_random}[300 - 350]%{/c} of its Shadow damage per second to surrounding enemies for every {c_number}30{/c} Essence you gain while it's active.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Urzael rent asunder his own wings and armor with a fury unbridled. For never would he bow to the doom of mortals, nor endure defeat at their lowly hands.
raw_en.name: The Unmaker

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}激活{c_important}灵魂裂隙{/c}时每消耗 {c_number}30{/c} 点精魂，其持续时间就会延长 {c_number}0.5{/c} 秒，最多可延长 {c_number}8{/c} 秒。

激活{c_important}灵魂裂隙{/c}时每获得 {c_number}30{/c} 点精魂，{c_important}灵魂裂隙{/c}每秒就会对周围敌人造成其 {c_random}[300 - 350]%{/c} 的暗影伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 厄兹尔怒不可遏地撕碎了自己的翅膀和盔甲。他绝不能接受自己像个凡人一样死去，更不消说成为这些低贱生灵的手下败将了。
raw_zh.name: 废命者

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Judicator{/c} Skills have up to a {c_random}[30 - 40]%{/c} chance to call down a {c_important}Blessed Spear{/c} that carries a {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} mark and deals {c_important}{u}Judgement's{/u}{/c} damage on impact.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Let the righteous spear judge what man cannot. Its point unmasks the heretic, its edge silences their defiance." - Judicator Moseph of the Fourth Inquisition
raw_en.name: Judicant's Glaivehelm

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_label}幸运一击: {/c}{c_important}审判者{/c}技能最多有 {c_random}[30 - 40]%{/c} 几率召唤一根带有{c_important}{u}审判{/u}{/c}印记的{c_important}祝福长矛{/c}，并在击中时造成{c_important}{u}审判{/u}{/c}的伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “让正义的长矛审判人类无法审判之物。其尖揭露异端，其刃平息彼之违抗。”——第四审判庭，审判官莫塞夫
raw_zh.name: 审判官的战刃盔

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}40%{/c} chance to trigger a large explosion, dealing {c_number}75%{/c} of the damage dealt and applying the {c_important}Imbuement{/c} effect to each enemy it hits with {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c} Potency.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"He is banished from the Guild, his name stricken from the Book. His punishment is to never have been." 
- Excerpt from a burned parchment
raw_en.name: Cowl of the Nameless

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_label}幸运一击:{/c} {c_important}被灌注{/c}的技能最多有 {c_number}40%{/c} 几率触发一次大爆炸，造成已造成伤害的 {c_number}75%{/c} 的伤害，并对命中的每个敌人施加{c_important}灌注{/c}效果，其强度为 {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: "他被逐出了公会，名字也从书中被划去。彻底抹除他的存在就是对他的惩罚。" - 摘录于一张烧焦的羊皮纸
raw_zh.name: 无名者兜帽

items.name_zh: 涅米特鲁克的死亡面具

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Flurry{/c} gains the Transporter Variant for free. You can now overexert yourself while Casting {c_important}Flurry{/c}, spending {c_number}3%{/c} life when you don't have enough Energy. Spending life to Cast {c_important}Flurry{/c} increases its damage by {c_random}[60.0 - 75.0]%[x]{/c} and your Attack Speed by {c_number}50%{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Beware, for the serpent's spirit lingers. Those who don the Nirmitruq's visage may find their hearts entwined with the viper's wrath.
raw_en.name: Deathmask of Nirmitruq

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}快刀乱刺{/c}免费获得穿梭者变体。施放{c_important}快刀乱刺{/c}时可以过度施法，能量不足时会消耗 {c_number}3%{/c} 生命。消耗生命施放{c_important}快刀乱刺{/c}会使其造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60.0 - 75.0]%[x]{/c}，并使你的攻击速度提高 {c_number}50%{/c}，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 当心，毒蛇之灵仍在世间游荡。无论何人，只要戴上涅米特鲁克的面具，或许便会惊觉，自己的内心已被那毒蛇的怨怒紧紧缠结，难脱难解。
raw_zh.name: 涅米特鲁克的死亡面具

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Meteor{/c} Casts consume {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} when possible, dropping an additional {c_important}Meteor{/c} for every {c_number}2{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} consumed. 

{c_important}Meteor{/c} deals {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The elders say they saw a star falling from the sky many years ago. A sign from the heavens that the end times were nigh. A rallying cry to take up arms and protect Sanctuary!"
- Crusader Hamilton
raw_en.name: Starfall Coronet

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}施放{c_important}陨石术{/c}会在可能时消耗{c_important}{u}压制{/u}{/c}，每消耗 {c_number}2{/c} 层{c_important}{u}压制{/u}{/c}就会额外砸下一颗{c_important}陨石{/c}。

{c_important}陨石术{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“长老们说在很多年前，曾看到一颗星辰从天空中坠落。这是天堂发出的讯号，宣告末日即将到来。同时也是在号召世人拿起武器，保卫庇护之地！”
——圣教军汉密尔顿
raw_zh.name: 星陨冠冕

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Gain {c_important}Ice Shards'{/c} {u}{c_important}Piercing Cold{/c}{/u} upgrade. {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} deals {c_random}[30 - 50]%[x]{/c} bonus damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Ere the age of mage and king, storms raged so dread and fell that men named it the wrath of gods. Its hail smote the earth till mountains were wrought..." -Tome recovered from Kasama
raw_en.name: Hail of Verglas

affixesDesc: {c_unique}获得{c_important}寒冰碎片{/c}的{u}{c_important}透体寒冰{/c}{/u}升级效果。{c_important}寒冰碎片{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[30 - 50]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “法师及王者未兴之际，尝有风暴肆虐，迅烈可怖，时人皆称其为众神之怒。风暴之中，冻雨出焉，化为雹霰，直击大地。天工日久，竟至造就山峦……”——卡萨玛古籍所载
raw_zh.name: 激飞冻雨

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Firewall{/c} has {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage and it's size is overcapped by {c_number}100%{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "From the Judgement of Inarius, the Firstborn faced suffering of all kinds. As the land of Atanos sank, the land of Skartara erupted..." -Tome recovered from Kasama
raw_en.name: Vision of the Firestorm

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}火墙{/c}的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}，并且范围上限额外扩大 {c_number}100%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “由于伊纳瑞斯的审判，初诞者们面临着各种各样的苦难。随着阿塔诺斯大陆沉没，斯卡塔拉大陆喷发了……”——从卡萨玛回收的典籍
raw_zh.name: 火焰风暴的幻象

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}According to your secondary Spirit Hall choice, your Skills are all additionally {c_important}Jaguar{/c}, {c_important}Eagle{/c}, {c_important}Gorilla{/c}, or {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skills.

Your Skills deal {c_random}[25 - 30]%[x]{/c} increased damage per Spirit type they have.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.
raw_en.name: Harmony of Ebewaka

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}基于你在众灵之厅做出的次要灵兽亲和选项，你的所有技能现在还会被视作{c_important}猎豹{/c}、{c_important}天鹰{/c}、{c_important}狂猿{/c}或{c_important}巨虫{/c}技能。

技能每拥有一种灵兽类型，你造成的伤害就会提高 {c_random}[25 - 30]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 只有埃贝瓦卡曾在众位守护者的领域中行走过。他死后，守护者们为了争夺他的灵魂，纷争不休，但无人能够取胜。无奈之下，他们这才停止争夺，并且放宽了限制，允许埃贝瓦卡在其所有领域中自由来去，漫步无羁。
raw_zh.name: 埃贝瓦卡之睦

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}While your Spirit Hall choices match:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Their bonuses are {c_number}100%{/c} more potent.
{icon:bullet,1.2} Skills of their Base Spirit gain {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} Vigor Cost Reduction.
{icon:bullet,1.2} Skills of their Base Spirit gain {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} Cooldown Reduction.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: During a Trial of Mists, a small spirit noticed an unclaimed boy. In pity, it spared him. "I will follow you always," vowed the boy. He remained true even after Ah Bulan called the spirit home.
raw_en.name: Loyalty's Mantle

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}当你在众灵之厅中的选择相匹配时:
{icon:bullet,1.2}它们的加成效果提高 {c_number}100%{/c}。
{icon:bullet,1.2}该基础灵力的技能获得 {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} 的精力消耗减免。
{icon:bullet,1.2}该基础灵力的技能获得 {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} 的冷却时间缩减。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 在一场迷雾试炼中，有个年轻的灵体发现了一个没人要的小男孩。它心存怜悯，便放过了他。于是，小男孩信誓旦旦地说：“我会永远追随你的。”而出乎意料的是，即便在阿布兰将灵体召回之后，男孩也依旧信守了他的承诺。
raw_zh.name: 忠诚斗篷

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} deals {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage and bursts out of enemies when you {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} them. {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} gains {c_random}[0.50 - 2.50]%[+]{/c} {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} Chance each second it has not {c_important}{u}Eviscerated{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Bind them as a sign on your hand, and the fiend shall be as frontlets between your eyes. Nail yourself to your crucibles, for pain is the road where domination is won." -The Magnus
raw_en.name: Nails of the Gore-Crowned

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}狱魔煞刺{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}，并且在你{c_important}{u}剔骨{/u}{/c}敌人时从敌人体内爆裂而出。{c_important}狱魔煞刺{/c}每有一秒未造成{c_important}{u}剔骨{/u}{/c}，其{c_important}{u}剔骨{/u}{/c}几率提高 {c_random}[0.50 - 2.50]%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “将它们如印记般系于腕上，恶魔便会如额带般伴你左右。把自己钉死在炼狱场之上吧，因为唯有苦痛，才是通向绝对支配的坦途。”——玛格努斯
raw_zh.name: 血冠者利爪

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} dooms enemies, maintaining the {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} and dealing {c_random}[100 - 200]%{/c} of {c_important}Doom's{/c} damage every second until they die. {c_important}Doom{/c} deals {c_random}[140 - 175]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The doomed do not fall at once. They linger, falter in purpose, and then unravel. Breath shortens. Will erodes. Fortune abandons them. When death finally comes, 'tis merely overdue." -Warlord Bartuc
raw_en.name: Cowl of Malefic Torment

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}{u}妖术{/u}{/c}会对敌人施加厄运，维持{c_important}{u}妖术{/u}{/c}，并在其死亡前每秒造成相当于{c_important}厄运{/c}伤害 {c_random}[100 - 200]%{/c} 的伤害。{c_important}厄运{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[140 - 175]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “命绝之人绝不会顷刻倒毙。他们会苟延残喘，会动摇犹疑，而后步入崩坏。他们的呼吸渐渐短促，意志被无情啃噬，好运也将他们无情抛弃。当死神终于叩门时，那只不过是一场迟来的清算罢了。”——督军巴图克
raw_zh.name: 恶念折磨之冠

raw_en.flavor: "Sin begets sins as men beget men. Terror begets Hate and Hate begets Destruction. Destruction begets Terror as Terror begets Hate..." -Inscription carved inside the helm
raw_en.name: Cage of Madness

raw_zh.flavor: 罪恶滋生罪恶，人类繁衍人类。恐惧滋生憎恨，憎恨引发毁灭，毁灭导致恐惧，继而恐惧滋生憎恨，憎恨引发毁灭，毁灭导致……
raw_zh.name: 癫狂牢笼

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Command Laalish{/c} is now an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill and deals {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c} increased damage. {c_important}Command Laalish's{/c} Terror Realm lasts {c_number}50%{/c} longer and while within your {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill casts do not break {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/c}{/u} {c_important}{u}Stealth{/c}{/u}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "We found eight corpses, arranged around a summoning circle. No wounds or blood. They were frozen in mid-scream. Whatever had appeared in the circle was gone." -Caldeum guard report
raw_en.name: Rictus of Terror

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}命令拉利什{/c}现在属于{c_important}终极{/c}技能，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}。{c_important}命令拉利什{/c}的恐怖领域持续时间延长 {c_number}50%{/c}；身处其中时，施放{c_important}深渊{/c}技能不会打破{c_important}{u}暗影形态{/c}{/u}的{c_important}{u}潜行{/c}{/u}状态。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我们发现了八具遗骸，环绕着一个召唤法阵排开。现场不见半点伤痕与血迹，所有人都僵死在了尖叫的那一瞬。无论法阵中究竟唤出了什么怪物，此刻都已荡然无存。”——卡尔蒂姆守卫报告
raw_zh.name: 骇怖苦笑

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} and {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} deal {c_random}[160 - 200]%[x]{/c} increased damage. {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} explodes all {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} instantly if there are at least {c_number}4{/c} total but enemy proximity no longer detonates them.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Destruction can be become an addiction, it is said. The first taste of it leaves you wanting more. Something within us craves ruin, yearns for annihilation." -Black Book of Lam Esen
raw_en.name: Bridle of Tor'Baalos

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}{u}硫磺石{/u}{/c}和{c_important}熔火炸弹{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[160 - 200]%[x]{/c}。如果场上至少有 {c_number}4{/c} 个{c_important}{u}硫磺石{/u}{/c}，{c_important}熔火炸弹{/c}会立即将其全部引爆，但敌人靠近不再引爆它们。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “古语云，毁灭使人沉沦。初尝其味，便觉欲罢不能。在我们内心极深处，无时无刻不在渴求着破败，期盼着湮灭。”——《兰姆·艾森的黑暗之书》
raw_zh.name: 巴洛斯的辔头

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your non-{c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills that summon Ancients will now summon an additional one. Skills that summon Ancients deal {c_random}[30.0 - 40.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Rise clansmen and reclaim our trampled honor! Ancients' blood runs through us all! We are storms: earth breaking, maelstrom wielding. The fire of the gods burn still! They are with us!" -Ealda
raw_en.name: Arreat's Bearing

affixesDesc: {c_unique}能够召唤先祖的非{c_important}终极{/c}技能现在会额外召唤一名先祖。能够召唤先祖的技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[30.0 - 40.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “崛起吧，族人们，找回我们被践踏的荣誉！我们身上流淌着先祖的血液！我们是风暴，撕裂大地，挥舞漩涡。众神之火仍在燃烧！他们与我们同在！”——伊达
raw_zh.name: 亚瑞特的承载

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting a damaging {c_important}Brawling{/c} Skill disables it afterwards. When all of these Skills that are on your Action Bar are disabled, they become re-enabled with their Cooldowns refreshed. {c_important}Brawling{/c} Skills you Cast deal {c_random}[80.0 - 100.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage for each disabled Skill.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: To chain the kin of Bul-Kathos is to gift them a weapon.
raw_en.name: Chainscourged Mail

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放造成伤害的{c_important}搏斗{/c}技能后会将其禁用。当你动作条上的所有此类技能都被禁用时，它们会重新启用并刷新冷却时间。每有一个被禁用的技能，你施放的{c_important}搏斗{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80.0 - 100.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 想用锁链拴住布尔凯索的族人，那就等于白送他们一件兵器。
raw_zh.name: 锁链鞭笞锁甲

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Wolf{/c} Companions are infused with the power of the storm, dealing {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased Lightning damage and gaining the {c_important}Storm Howl{/c} ability.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The storm's rage is my own, brother. I call, and the skies roar in reply."
- Vasily, to Bul-Kathos
raw_en.name: Storm's Companion

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}狼{/c}同伴被注入了风暴的力量，造成的闪电伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}，并获得{c_important}风暴嚎叫{/c}技能。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “风暴之怒即为我怒，兄弟。听我一声长啸，天空轰然回响。” - 瓦西里对布尔凯索说
raw_zh.name: 风暴之友

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Ravens{/c} deal {c_random}[80.0 - 100.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage and {c_important}Shapeshifting{/c} into a different form or activating a {c_important}Companion{/c} Skill {c_important}Summons{/c} a {c_important}Raven{/c} that attacks nearby enemies. {c_important}Summoning{/c} a {c_important}Raven{/c} has a chance to call forth an Unkindness for {c_number}10{/c} seconds, increasing the number of {c_important}Ravens{/c} {c_important}Summoned{/c} to {c_number}3{/c} for the duration.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The moors once belonged to the raven-changelings, child. They came with the full moon and read fate through the eyes of the dead. But that time has withered. Their songs are stilled." - Airidah
raw_en.name: Kilt of Blackwing

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}渡鸦{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80.0 - 100.0]%[x]{/c}。{c_important}变形{/c}为另一种形态或激活{c_important}同伴{/c}技能时，会{c_important}召唤{/c}一只{c_important}渡鸦{/c}攻击附近的敌人。{c_important}召唤{/c}{c_important}渡鸦{/c}时有几率唤来一群渡鸦，持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒，在此期间将{c_important}召唤{/c}的{c_important}渡鸦{/c}数量增加至 {c_number}3{/c} 只。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “这片荒野曾经属于渡鸦变形怪，孩子。它们在满月时分降临，从亡者的双眼中占卜命运。可那个时代早已凋零，它们的歌声也归于沉寂。” - 艾蕊达
raw_zh.name: 黑翼幽裙

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Effects that Heal you beyond {c_number}100%{/c} Life grant you {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} equal to {c_random}[80 - 100]%{/c} of the overhealed amount that lasts for {c_number}8{/c} seconds. 

You may now drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The revelation that master tailor Callas was in fact a witch only served to further fuel the desire for her uniquely enchanted legwraps."
- Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Temerity

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}任何治疗你超过 {c_number}100%{/c} 生命的效果，都会给予你相当于过量治疗量 {c_random}[80 - 100]%{/c} 的{c_important}{u}屏障{/u}{/c}，持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒。

你现在可在生命值全满时饮用治疗药水。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “裁缝大师卡拉斯实际是一位女巫的真相被揭穿后，她那双具有独特附魔效果的绑腿更加令人垂涎。” - 巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 骄狂

affixesDesc: {c_unique}When you take damage from a Non-Physical damage type, you gain {c_random}[130.0 - 160.0]%[+]{/c} Resistance to that damage type for {c_number}6{/c} seconds. This effect can only apply to one damage type at a time.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
“May the Light of Father Inarius shine down upon all weary travelers of this holy land. Turn your face toward his radiance and find your strength renewed.”
- Statue Inscription
raw_en.name: Tassets of the Dawning Sky

affixesDesc: {c_unique}受到非物理伤害时，你会获得 {c_random}[130.0 - 160.0]%[+]{/c} 对该类型伤害的抗性，持续 {c_number}6{/c} 秒。同一时间该效果只能作用于一种伤害类型。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“愿天父伊纳瑞斯的圣光照亮这片圣地上所有疲惫的旅行者。将脸朝向他的光辉, 你就会重新焕发力量。”
 - 雕像铭文
raw_zh.name: 破晓天空裙甲

affixesDesc: {c_unique}You deal {c_random}[15 - 20]%[x]{/c} increased damage and gain {c_number}25{/c} Primary Resource Regeneration while {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} and for {c_number}5{/c} seconds after.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The younger apprentices think wearing heavy plate in the swamps is foolish. They fail to understand that our armor is our legacy, and without it we are nothing."
- Crusader Pembroke
raw_en.name: Tibault's Will

affixesDesc: {c_unique}在{c_important}{u}不可阻挡{/u}{/c}状态下以及之后的 {c_number}5{/c} 秒内，你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[15 - 20]%[x]{/c}，并且获得 {c_number}25{/c} 点主要资源回复速度。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “年轻的侍从们认为在沼泽中穿戴重型板甲是愚蠢行为。他们不明白，我们的盔甲就是我们的传承，没有了它，我们便一文不值。” - 圣教军彭布罗克
raw_zh.name: 迪博特的意志

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Summons{/c} have a {c_random}[7.0 - 10.0]%{/c} chance to randomly inflict {c_important}Decrepify{/c} or {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} when they deal damage.  

You deal {c_random}[50 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage to enemies affected by your {c_important}Curses{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A naturally occurring curiosity, the blood moon persists as a sign of woe for the most superstitious Zakarum faithful. Children born under it are often considered cursed and cast out, lest it spread.
raw_en.name: Blood Moon Breeches

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}召唤物{/c}在造成伤害时，有 {c_random}[7.0 - 10.0]%{/c} 几率随机对敌人施加{c_important}衰老{/c}或{c_important}铁处女{/c}效果。

当敌人身上带有你的{c_important}诅咒{/c}时，你对其造成的暴击伤害提高 {c_random}[50 - 60]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 血月是一种自然存在的奇观，最迷信的萨卡兰姆虔信者认为它是苦痛的预兆。他们认为血月下出生的孩子受到了诅咒，会将其放逐以免诅咒扩散。
raw_zh.name: 血月马裤

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Blood Wave{/c} now forms a wave on each side of you. Both waves converge at your feet, Pulling In all surrounding enemies and exploding for {c_random}[375 - 450]{/c} damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Too soon she was taken, yet Rathma let Kessime rest in death, for they both had found peace in the cycle. Upon the hill where she lay, Rathma poured forth his blood and no evil trod thereafter..."
raw_en.name: Kessime's Legacy

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}血潮{/c}现在会在你的两侧形成两道浪潮。这两道浪潮会在你的脚下汇聚，拉近所有附近敌人并产生爆炸，造成 {c_random}[375 - 450]{/c} 点伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “凯希米很快就被带走了，但拉斯玛却让她得到了安息——看来，他们俩都在生死轮回中寻得了安宁。在她长眠的那座山上，拉斯玛洒下了自己的鲜血。从此，再也没有邪恶的足迹……”
raw_zh.name: 凯希米的传承

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Blood Wave{/c} is additionally a {c_important}Bone{/c} Skill. It spawns a {c_important}Bone Prison{/c} at its end point and increases your {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill damage by {c_random}[20 - 40]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}8{/c} seconds when Cast.

All {c_important}Bone Spears{/c} are additionally {c_important}Blood{/c} Skills. Your {c_important}Bone Spears{/c} consume a Corpse to launch another {c_important}Bone Spear{/c} and drain {c_number}10%{/c} of your Maximum Life.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The tears of Linarian turned bloody over Indira's torn body. Many days, unyielding, he poured his magic into sundered bone and rended sinew. Though the flesh did mend, his beloved did not rise..."
raw_en.name: Indira's Memory

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}血潮{/c}额外算作{c_important}白骨{/c}技能。它会在终点处生成一个{c_important}骨牢{/c}，并且施放时使你的{c_important}鲜血{/c}技能伤害提高{c_random}[20 - 40]%[x]{/c}，持续{c_number}8{/c}秒。

所有{c_important}骨矛{/c}额外算作{c_important}鲜血{/c}技能。每次施放{c_important}骨矛{/c}时，消耗一具亡骸，额外施放一支{c_important}骨矛{/c}，吸取你生命上限的{c_number}10%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “利纳瑞安的眼泪洒在英迪拉残损的遗体上，立刻变得殷红如血。一天又一天过去了，他依旧不屈不挠，不断给破碎的骨头和撕裂的肌腱注入魔法。后来，遗体的肉身的确愈合了，但他的爱人却没有再度归来……”
raw_zh.name: 英迪拉的记忆

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Rally{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_random}[6.0 - 8.0]%{/c} of your Maximum Life. Whenever you recover {c_number}8%{/c} of your Maximum Life, gain a charge of {c_important}Rally{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: No wasteland may weary the bearer of Arcadia. Beneath their path, the soil remembers its first spring, and blades of war soften into petals.
raw_en.name: Arcadia

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}英勇集结{/c}使你获得相当于生命上限 {c_random}[6.0 - 8.0]%{/c} 的{c_important}{u}强固{/u}{/c}。每当你恢复 {c_number}8%{/c} 的生命上限时，获得一层{c_important}英勇集结{/c}充能。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 没有荒原能使阿卡迪亚的持有者疲惫。在他们足下，土壤记起初春，战争的刀刃软化为花瓣。
raw_zh.name: 阿卡迪亚
